cohort: The study included pregnant women with cardiac disease admitted to Cheluvamba hospital, Mysore, India, between January 2022 and June 2023.
finding: The incidence of cardiac disease in pregnancy at the study center was 0.44%, with RHD being the most common, and various maternal and perinatal morbidities were observed.
mod_finding: The study found that the number of lower segment cesarean sections (LSCS) was higher compared to vaginal deliveries.
